name: tavernweave-agent-skills
description: A routed SillyTavern and Vibe Coding system with 21 focused skills, natural prose refinement, full and architecture reviews, bounded brainstorming, immutable growth reflection, a complete screened library, evidence gates, and portable Soul modes.

interface.shortDescription: Design, build, verify, and learn SillyTavern rolecards.
interface.longDescription: TavernWeave 1.4.0 combines 21 skills: prose refinement with one-shot, task, approved workspace and client persistence; full and architecture reviews for software and rolecards with explicit coverage; brainstorming, immutable growth reflection, the complete library, and portable Soul modes.
defaultPrompt: 洗稿这段文字，保留原意、人物声音和技术结构。
全量架构审查这个项目，保留覆盖缺口和全部有证据的发现，先交只读报告。
脑暴模式，Soul 联席：帮我把这个想法收束成总设计案、第一版合同和不会递归膨胀的执行蓝图。
按蓝图开跑第一版；只执行已确认的 First Playable，运行时不要新增子蓝图。
照镜子：从当前可用证据重新核验我的完整 Vibe Code 成长历程；同时给我一份完整文字评估表单和七章交互报告，如有旧履历，只比较量表可比的维度。
阿瞳助我！用当前任务级温柔指导模式帮我完成这张角色卡。
MTTT.sir，拷打我！检查我是否真的理解这次 Vibe Code 的架构与验收。
灵魂杀手！用强尼·银手彩蛋人格审查这个前端，并给出最多三条有证据的 Relic 故障。
Route this task through TavernWeave Library, read A0, and load only the smallest relevant guide set.
Design a maintainable SillyTavern rolecard and choose the right TavernWeave skill.
Update only a rolecard regex or Tavern Helper script and emit an importable test artifact without repacking the card.
Validate this rolecard's regex stages, security surface, and structured data migrations with deterministic fixtures.
Scaffold and statically validate a SillyTavern UI extension without installing it into the host.
Measure a large rolecard against static and captured runtime performance budgets.
Validate rolecard audio and Live2D assets, preload policy, fallbacks, and lifecycle cleanup.
Detect which rolecard dependencies must be embedded, enabled in the host, or loaded remotely.
Audit this rolecard source and prepare the smallest safe release workflow.
Reproduce this rolecard UI issue in SillyTavern and identify the owning layer.
